summary: EquipmentShare.com Inc filed an 8-K disclosing the launch of a private offering of $1,050 million aggregate principal amount of senior secured second lien notes due 2034. The notes are offered to qualified institutional investors under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. The company also disclosed an additional $555 million in borrowings under its asset-based revolving credit facility since March 31, 2026. This is a routine debt financing transaction not constituting a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing provides no terms such as price per share, premium, or deal-related mechanics beyond the note offering and additional borrowing disclosure.
